collection.stop_rule: collect all eight fixed slots before evaluation; retain every physical HIT; reject and retry only infrastructure-invalid or Bomb-bearing attempts; stop incomplete after three infrastructure attempts for any slot

decision: Does the untouched L2 full current-root/action probe independently reproduce its 16-frame HIT Brier increment on new complete Stage 4 episodes, and does that increment survive known-nonbaseline support, pre-first-HIT lifecycle, and calibration gates?

gate.nonbaseline_support: published-differs-from-baseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, and have negative point Brier delta
gate.overall_signal: 16-frame complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for full minus state-only Brier is below zero
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, and have negative point Brier delta

hypotheses.H1_independent_replication: On eight wholly new complete physical episodes, the frozen full model has a 16-frame complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint below zero for Brier minus the frozen state-only model, with sufficient HIT support and at least six episode directions favoring full.
hypotheses.H2_nonbaseline_support: The 16-frame full-minus-state-only point delta is negative on actions known to differ from the reactive baseline, with at least 100 positive windows and rows from all eight episodes.
hypotheses.H3_prefirst_hit_lifecycle: The 16-frame point delta is negative before the first HIT, with at least 64 positive windows and rows from all eight episodes; HIT still does not terminate collection or evaluation.
hypotheses.H4_calibration_readiness: The full model's absolute calibration-in-the-large is at most 0.002 and its ECE exceeds state-only by at most 0.001 on the fresh primary view.
hypotheses.H5_claim_boundary: Even a complete pass confirms only logged-action predictive signal. It does not identify a causal action value, admit a critic/history/policy, or constitute gameplay improvement.

non_goals: no refit, calibration transform, model selection, feature change, horizon change, history, MLP, object encoder, IQL, OPE, actor, critic, or learned online policy
no counterfactual successor and no inference of latent mixture membership when the published action equals baseline
no stage, boss, spell, ECL, RNG, source, run identity, or time-since-HIT actor input
no retry, truncation, or sequential stop because of a physical HIT or interim metric
no HIT reduction, NMNB, causal action-effect, or promotion claim
